pr.title: feat(dcp): TP-103 schema-driven rules loader + scanner hardening
pr.body:
## Summary
- Adds `load_taxonomy(path) -> list[Rule]` to `red_lane_rules.py`: compiles patterns at load, stamps each Rule with `lane_id` (new field).
- Adds `Finding.lane_id` passthrough in `red_lane.py` (additive minor bump to report schema).
- Regenerates `FROZEN_FALLBACK_RULES` to cover ALL hard_block lanes (including the 4 new ones from TP-102) — CI hard-block-equality test enforces coverage.
- Adds `--packet-id` to `main()` argparse in `red_lane_scanner.py`, removing the TP-DCP-0005 hardcode.
- Scanner hardening: absent identity fields in completed-packet proofs raise WARNING (self-cert truthiness fix); `diff_text` either implemented or parameter removed with rationale recorded; gh api pattern tightened to executable path_scope.
- Loader is flag-gated: defaults to FROZEN_FALLBACK_RULES until flag is set.
- Behavioral equivalence corpus scoped to the 5 pre-existing rules only.

## Depends on
DMX-DCP-TOOLING-102 (taxonomy instance must be present before loader can reference it).

## Scope
Runtime source files only: red_lane_rules.py, red_lane_scanner.py, and red_lane.py. No CI workflow edits (those are in TP-104).

## NOT_RUN
Direct CI gate integration (TP-104), surface_guard coupling (TP-105), live PR scanning.

Read red_lane_rules.py, red_lane_scanner.py, and red_lane.py in full to establish baseline: current Rule fields, Finding fields, FORBIDDEN_PATHS/TEXT_RULES shape, main() argparse parameters, diff_text handling, self-cert check, and the 5 pre-existing rules that define the equivalence corpus.

The loader function is flag-gated: a module-level flag USE_TAXONOMY_LOADER=False defaults to FROZEN_FALLBACK_RULES; when True, load_taxonomy() is used. Add Finding.lane_id as an additive field (optional, None when not set by legacy paths). Per design B.3.

steps.task: Regenerate FROZEN_FALLBACK_RULES in red_lane_rules.py: the existing FORBIDDEN_PATHS/TEXT_RULES become FROZEN_FALLBACK_RULES. Regenerate to cover ALL hard_block-lane detectors from config/dcp/red_lane_taxonomy.json — including the 4 new lanes (DOPETASK-EXECUTION, FORBIDDEN-NETWORK-CALL, LIVE-WRITE-CREEP, STALE-PROOF) and all existing hard_block lanes. Per design B.3 fallback policy: fail-closed for hard_block lanes under any load failure. Add a module docstring comment identifying FROZEN_FALLBACK_RULES as static — no live reads at this scope.
validation: FROZEN_FALLBACK_RULES covers all hard_block lanes from the taxonomy (verified by the CI hard-block-equality test in S4).
Module still imports without errors.
Behavioral equivalence corpus test (5 pre-existing rules) still passes — existing rules are preserved in the fallback.

steps.task: Add --packet-id to main() argparse in red_lane_scanner.py. Remove or update any hardcoded TP-DCP-0005 string. Address diff_text: either implement actual diff-text scanning or remove the parameter from the public API with rationale recorded in a code comment (decision must be explicit — no silent dead input). Fix self-cert truthiness: change the self-certification check from `if impl and auditor` to require that identity fields are present and non-empty in a completed-packet proof context; absent fields raise a WARNING finding. Per design A.7 hardening items.

Per design B.3 and plan FEAS-5/FEAS-6.
